title: Width and height in the transform values keep their proportion, with a link to turn it off
goal: The transform mock draws a link between width and height, so typing a new width brings the height along. Today the two are independent. The floating bar this was filed against has since been replaced by the Info popover on the tool bar, so the link belongs there: on by default, one click to unlink.
notes:
Left from a-small-overlay-shows-transform-values-to-type-i (2026-10-13). Bar view: Sources/Photonz/TransformValueBar.swift; values land through EditorState+TransformBar.swift setTransformBarValue via LayerGeometrySelection.applying. Mock: .va-link in video-animate.html buildBar (between W and H). The mock models size as one scale percentage, which is why its W and H move together.

Triage 2026-10-13: the canvas bar (TransformValueBar.swift) this was filed against was replaced the same night by TransformValuesPopover.swift (task transform-values-live-behind-an-info-button-on-t, commit 1cd96c89). Build the link there.
acceptance: The transform values popover (the tool bar Info button) shows a link between W and H, drawn as pages/video-animate.html draws it between the two fields
With the link on, a width typed into the popover changes the height in proportion, in one undo step, and the reverse
Clicking the link turns it off and on, and the state reads back to a walk
A walk at Next defaults opens Info on a picked layer, types a width with the link on and checks both numbers, then unlinks and checks the height stays

log.note: triage 2026-10-13: retargeted from the floating bar (now gone) to the Info popover that replaced it; moved to p2 because the loop filed it as a follow-up, not the user, and the user's own p1 asks go first

Adversarial pass: a Photoshop user expects the chain between W and H, on by default, typed values only (handles keep Shift); the mock's horizontal link becomes a bracket joining the W and H rows since the popover lists one value per row. Rough items in the audit: layout (settled by the 2026-10-12 popover move), link lifetime per window (asked in evaluate, no task: nobody hits it yet), handles not following the link (Photoshop parity, log only), link hidden where height is not typeable (by design). No follow-ups filed. No menu bar entry: it is a setting on the popover, not a command.

Info popover joins W and H with a bracket and chain, on by default; typing or stepping W brings H along in proportion (and the reverse) in one undo step, one click unlinks. Core LayerGeometrySelection inProportion with 5 new tests; full suite 13,123 green; transform-values-link-walk (Next defaults, no flags) ok, transform-values-info-walk and 3d-grippers walk ok.
